overview:
The **Battle of Ajan Kloss** (35 ABY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Cold War**, fought on or above **Ajan Kloss**. Resistance command center on ajan kloss mobilizing the final fleet muster against exegol while starfighters launch through jungle canopy bunkers.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Cold War in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Battle of Ajan Kloss within the broader **Cold War** campaign. Front-line reports describe resistance command center on ajan kloss mobilizing the final fleet muster against exegol while starfighters launch through jungle canopy bunkers.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **35 ABY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Cold War.
significance: The Battle of Ajan Kloss illustrates how the Cold War reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
